newsitem.title: HONG KONG: KTP Holdings plans 1-for-4 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: KTP Holdings plans 1-for-4 rights issue.

text.p: KTP Holdings Ltd said on Monday it proposed a one-for-four rights issue at HK$0.23 per rights share to raise a minimum of about HK$78.34 million, before expenses, to reduce debts.
The sports shoes maker said it planned to issue between 340.62 million and 344.80 million rights shares, depending on the level of rights exercised by outstanding share options.
The subscription price represented a disount of about 26.98 percent to the share's closing price of HK$0.315 on Friday, it said in a statement.

KTP said it would use about HK$69 million of the proceeds to reduce the group's syndicated loan to about HK$48 million from HK$117 million and the remaining balance to provide additional working capital.
The company and its subsidiaries had outstanding liabilities of about HK$820 million at the end of March 31, 1996, its annual financial documents showed.
Amsteel Securities (H.K.) Ltd has been appointed the principal underwirter of the issue, it added.
